stem: In the inequality \(\frac{x + k}{3} < 2x - 1\), \(k\) is a constant. If the solution set of the inequality is \(x > 2\), what is the value of \(k\)?
solution: The solution set is \(x > 2\), so \(\frac{k + 3}{5} = 2\) and \(k = 7\).
verify:
x, k = symbols('x k')
assert solve(Eq((k + 3)/5, 2), k) == [7]
s = solve_univariate_inequality((x + 7)/3 < 2*x - 1, x, relational=False)
assert s == Interval.open(2, oo)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [7]
